thread:
Maya (AE): Ledgerly POC ask: 3-week pilot, VPC-only, CMK/HSM, no external logs. They estimate 15k DAU, ~1.5 calls/user/day, avg ~70 tokens/request, marketing pushes sometimes. Need tight cost bands + explicit SOW success criteria. Kickoff in 2 weeks if ok.
Ibrahim (SE): Quick token calc: 15k * 1.5 * 70 = 1,575,000 tokens/day -> ~44.25M tokens/month. For 3-week pilot that's ~11M? hold on: 1.575M/day * 21 = 33.075M total tokens for pilot.
Ruth (Infra): Baseline throughput: assume 150 RPS steady -> 150*70=10.5k tok/s. Spikes reported up to 1,500 RPS for short bursts -> 105k tok/s.
Hector (SRE): GPU throughput rough rules: small GPU ~1.2k tok/s, mid ~3k tok/s, large ~7k tok/s. For 10.5k tok/s -> ~4 mid GPUs or ~2 large GPUs. For 105k tok/s bursts -> ~35 mid GPUs or ~15 large GPUs ephemeral.
Ibrahim (SE): For pilot we can present two pragmatic plans:
- Lean (budget-first): sample 20% of traffic, prefix caching, pre-filter on CPU to short-circuit chit-chat, reserve 1 large GPU for critical path + small mid-GPU autoscale pool for day bursts.
- Perf (latency-first): reserve 2 large GPUs 24/7 + burst pool of mid GPUs.
Maya (AE): Customer target pilot budget: ~12k. Which plan fits?
Ruth (Infra): Cost sketch (cloud-equivalent estimates): large GPU ~$45/hr, mid GPU ~$12/hr.
Lean plan infra: reserve 1 large 12h/day + autoscale up to 6 mid GPUs on-demand (spots) -> infra ~ $6k for 3 weeks. Platform & token fees estimate $2.5-$4k (depends on negotiated token price) -> total ~$8.5-$10k.
Perf plan infra: reserve 2 large 24/7 + burst mid pool -> infra ~ $20k+, platform/token ~$4-6k -> total ~ $24k-$27k.
Ibrahim (SE): Hybrid recommendation for Ledgerly POC: Offer Lean as default with an optional "upgrade" to Perf if quality gates fail. Use staged ramp: 10% -> 40% -> 100% (only if eval pass). Host fallback for overflow to avoid hard failures.
Zoe (Security): Confirming security needs: VPC peering, CMK with customer rotation policy, HSM for keys if they insist, audit logs exported to their S3 for 90 days, no third-party logging. Questionnaire turnaround requested in 48 hours.
Hector (SRE): Suggested SOW success criteria (explicit pass/fail):
1) Latency: p95 <= 700ms for the staged 40% traffic window.
2) Reliability: end-to-end error rate <= 1.5% across pilot.
3) Quality: >= 91% intent-match on a 180-prompt eval (automated metrics + 20 manual spot checks).
4) Cost cap for Lean plan: <= $11.5k (infra + platform + token fees).
5) Security: VPC peering + CMK/HSM validated; no data egress to third parties.
Ibrahim (SE): I'll prepare the 180-prompt eval (mix of short intents, multi-turn context, long-context summarization, and privacy probes). Example eval item we'll use:
```
{"prompt": "Summarize this dispute: user reports double charge txn 5555 on 2026-03-10 for $9.99", "expected": "User double-charged $9.99 on txn 5555; escalate to billing"}
```
Hector (SRE): Load test plan (staging):
```
heyload --rps 150 --burst-rps 1500 --burst-duration 120 --duration 12m --payload=ledgerly_staging_prompts.json --concurrency 120
```
Ruth (Infra): Runbook timeline: network/KMS approvals 2-3 business days, reserve infra provisioning 1-2 business days, autoscale + canary routing + trace hooks 3 business days.
Maya (AE): I'll present Lean plan as default with a clear upgrade path and explicit quality gates. Also will ask if they'd accept a 20% sampling initial week to keep cost low.
ProvisionBot: reservation created: ledgerly-poc-512 (status: awaiting_network)
Zoe (Security): I'll draft questionnaire answers: CMK policy, HSM requirement options, retention windows, and minimal audit pipeline. Need internal review before sending.
Maya (AE): Thanks all 44d I'll bundle this into the SOW: lean plan + perf upgrade, success criteria above, runbook, and questionnaire deadline (48h). Target kickoff in 12 business days pending approvals.
